newsitem.title: JAPAN: March JGB futures end higher after earlier dive.
newsitem.headline: March JGB futures end higher after earlier dive.

text.p: The key March Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract ended Thursday's Tokyo session higher, after plunging early in the morning on a former senior Finance Ministry official's remarks, traders said.
The March closed up 0.16 at 126.34, exactly one yen above its intraday low of 125.34.

The earlier plunge was triggered by former MOF Vice Minister for International Affairs Makoto Utsumi's comment that Japanese bonds were overpriced and the Bank of Japan (BOJ) wanted to make an upward correction in its official discount rate, currently standing at a record low of 0.5 percent.
